decision: Illustrative class-level Neo-Hookean model; no grade calibration or data fitting claimed.

sources.review: Public indexed grade data give discrete tensile stress values with test conditions and compression-set properties. These are not a complete multiaxial/compression/volumetric dataset for this unidentified specimen. Direct page fetch returned403. No parameters adopted or fitted.

Manufacturer supplies typical tensile modulus, strength and elongation, cure and mixing context. This is a distinct silicone grade, not the chosen polymer identity; no complete compression/volumetric calibration extracted and no coefficients adopted.
